concepts.title: Four Major Domains of the Earth
concepts.definition: The environment of the Earth is composed of four principal realms: the land surface, the surrounding atmospheric air, all global water bodies, and the living sphere.
concepts.key_idea: Interlinked realms of land, air, and water interact to form the environment supporting life.

solution_steps.explain: Identify the four main realms: lithosphere, atmosphere, hydrosphere, and biosphere.
Lithosphere comprises solid land, atmosphere holds gaseous air, hydrosphere contains water in all forms, and biosphere harbors living organisms.

concepts.title: Lithospheric Elevation and Vertical Relief
concepts.definition: The solid outer surface of the Earth, including landmasses and ocean floors, where elevation and depth are measured relative to sea level.
concepts.key_idea: Sea level serves as the zero reference datum for calculating heights and ocean trench depths.

solution_steps.explain: Add the altitude above sea level to the ocean depth below sea level to obtain total vertical relief

concepts.title: Continents and Geographic Divisions
concepts.definition: Large, continuous terrestrial landmasses separated by major oceans, predominantly situated across the Northern Hemisphere.
concepts.key_idea: Seven distinct continents make up the land portion of the Earth's surface.

concepts.title: Hydrosphere and Water Proportions
concepts.definition: The domain encompassing all forms of water on Earth, divided into vast ocean saltwater and a small fraction of fresh water.
concepts.key_idea: Over 97% of Earth's water is salty ocean water, leaving under 3% as fresh water.

concepts.title: Oceanic Basins and Characteristics
concepts.definition: Vast interconnected basins of saline water undergoing continuous motion through waves, tides, and currents.
concepts.key_idea: Five major oceans differ in extent, shape, coastline indentation, and land boundaries.

concepts.title: Atmospheric Composition and Gaseous Volumes
concepts.definition: The protective gaseous blanket surrounding Earth, structured into five layers and dominated by nitrogen and oxygen.
concepts.key_idea: Air consists primarily of 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen, with density decreasing with elevation.

concepts.title: Biosphere and Environmental Equilibrium
concepts.definition: The narrow intersection of land, water, and air where life forms flourish and interact in plant and animal kingdoms.
concepts.key_idea: Human activity disrupting land, water, or air can destabilize global climate and natural balance.
